description: This file is a header (.h) file for JNI (Java Native Interface) functions used in the TensorFlow Java project. It declares external function(s) for resolving outputs in the native layer, referencing TensorFlow C API, and includes macro guards.

methods.name: resolveOutputs
methods.description: A function declared for resolving tensor outputs in the JNI context, taking JVM environment, type string, source operation array, source index array, destination output array, and count.
